name: Yippee Noodles
ingredients_raw: Instant noodles: maida (refined wheat flour) (78.7%), edible vegetable oil, iodized salt, wheat gluten (0.4%), thickeners (508, 412), acidity regulators [501(i), 500(i)], stabilizer [339(ii)]. Seasoning: masala mix: dehydrated vegetables [beans (9.5%), carrot (7.1%), onion (4.6%), cabbage (3.8%)], instant noodle powder {maida (refined wheat flour) (15.9%), edible vegetable oil, iodized salt, wheat gluten (0.07%)}, spices and condiments (17.6%) [garlic, coriander, cumin, dried ginger, chillies, aniseed, fenugreek, black pepper, cardamom, nutmeg, caraway, cinnamon, cloves, turmeric], sugar, iodized salt, hydrolyzed vegetable protein (defatted soya, maltodextrin), natural flavours and natural flavouring substances, yeast extract, acidity regulator (330), nature identical flavouring substances, flavour enhancer (635). Sprinkler mix (topping): spices & condiments (67.8%) [garlic, chilli flakes, black pepper bits], dehydrated onion, iodized salt, flavour enhancer (635), acidity regulator (330), nature identical flavouring substances.
